newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian rupee dips as RBI buys forward dollars.
newsitem.headline: Indian rupee dips as RBI buys forward dollars.

text.p: The rupee weakened against the forward dollar on purchases by the Reserve Bank of India (RBI), dealers said on Monday.
"They are now buying January dollars," said a dealer. "Earlier they bought December dollars."
January dollars were quoted at 74/77 paise in early afternoon trade from 69/71 opening, dealers said.
Premiums on far-forward maturities also rose in sympathy.
The spot dollar was quoted at 35.742/750 in latest trade. Earlier on Monday, RBI bought spot dollars too, dealers said.
